goal.en: Keep reporting relationships, documents and revision history together in workspaces, with web and CLI access to the same knowledge base.
goal.zh: 围绕人物和工作空间整理组织关系、文档和版本记录，并用网页与命令行维护同一份知识库。

服务端数据与页面导航

validation.result: Clean main and fresh git pull --ff-only succeeded in isolated checkout; original checkout with four unrelated commits untouched.
bun install --frozen-lockfile passed with normal Husky; no lockfile changes.
bun run build passed shared TypeScript build and UI build. Existing bundle-size warning only; no tracked generated differences.
Existing full shared, Worker and UI unit coverage command passed all thresholds; exact test summaries in /tmp/readme-bogo-unit-tests.log.
bun run seed:local applied all local migrations and loaded Northwind Labs in this isolated checkout. No remote database writes.

CLI source build and generated --help passed using a process-local clip launcher backed by synchronized clip source. All four Chromium browser tests passed with CI=1, local Worker port 27036 and an isolated .wrangler/e2e-pw D1. Deployment credentials were removed from the child process. Normal hooks subsequently passed, including the required CLI E2E cases; see the publication receipt.

Website HEAD returns Cloudflare Access login. Public npm @nocoo/bogo latest is 0.5.0 versus repository 0.8.1, matching nocoo maintainer/bin/repository. Root and CLI licenses are MIT; no real login performed.
All 15 local references per language resolve; all Bash examples match. No 6DQ, fixed test counts or gate/hook governance in README.

Unmodified hooks passed; pre-push executed all 77 local API tests, CLI schema generation and all three generated-CLI login/CRUD/revocation tests with BOGO_REQUIRE_CLI_E2E=1. Fresh pull before push; no source/version/lock changes.

Complete normal gate:security rerun passed after git fetch --refetch --no-filter restored full history. OSV scanned 391 dependencies with no issues; gitleaks scanned all 332 commits with no leaks and no fetch errors. Initial partial scan is not used as evidence. Log /tmp/readme-bogo-security-complete.log.

publication.prePushPull: Fresh git pull --ff-only origin main succeeded; only the reviewed README commit was ahead.
publication.remoteReadback: All three README byte sequences match local through GitHub Contents API at main (5921, 6351 and 2531 bytes); clean synchronized main.
publication.hooks: Normal pre-commit and pre-push passed unit coverage, types/lint, route/page checks, 77 local API tests, clip schema generation and all three CLI login/CRUD/revocation tests. After a transient partial-clone fetch error, the complete history was hydrated and the normal security gate rerun: OSV no issues, gitleaks all 332 commits scanned with no leaks or fetch errors. No checks skipped.
